parole.significato: amba (a blended mash of mainly pickled mango, used as a side dish or condiment)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Iraqi Arabic عَمْبَة (ʕamba, “amba”), from Marathi आंबा (āmbā).

parole.testo: From Judeo-Iraqi Arabic צ׳חלה (čāḥla), which is a pet form of the given name רָחֵל (rakhél). The sense "bimbo, chick" comes from the popularity of the name among Iraqi Jewish women in the mid-20th century.
